races.name: Roxyfet Sports Lounge For Private Hire Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Thriving FAIRLAWN SKIPPER can defy a penalty for last week's success at Newton Abbot. Paddy De Pole won this corresponding event 12 months ago, and he's the main danger for a yard that does well here.

  1. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER
  2. PADDY DE POLE (IRE)
  3. PARIKARMA (IRE)

races.name: Fairlight Studios Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Having made a promising start over hurdles, TRALEE GIRL hasn't been at her best in 2 outings this year but she's well worth another chance returning from a break for her leading yard. You Be Lucky Jean was successful both starts in bumpers and is feared most, while Mia Sunshine is respected given her ability on the Flat.

  1. TRALEE GIRL (IRE)
  2. YOU BE LUCKY JEAN
  3. MIA SUNSHINE (GER)

races.name: MW Civils & Groundworks Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
Given another try over fences, JETEYE opened his chase account at the third attempt at Cartmel in July before not seen to best effect over this C&D last time. He is taken to resume winning ways in a change of headgear, with Aill Dubh the pick for second having been in good heart prior to his latest effort.

  1. JETEYE (IRE)
  2. AILL DUBH (IRE)
  3. BAHTIYAR (FR)

races.name: Bill & Teresa Florentines 50th Anniversary Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MR MCWHINNY has made a promising start for this stable, making it 2 wins from 4 outings when scoring in impressive fashion at Newton Abbot a week ago, so he looks to hold leading claims able to race without a penalty here. The biggest threat could come from Tom Creen, who is now 9 lb below his last winning mark.

  1. MR MCWHINNY (IRE)
  2. TOM CREEN (IRE)
  3. ACHILLE DES ROCS (FR)

races.name: Paxtons No1 CaseIH Dealer Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BENY NAHAR ROAD has run well on both previous starts at this course, and he could be worth chancing off his slipping mark following a breathing operation. Aimeric and William Yeats are feared most, with both still potentially well treated following their tussle over C&D last time.

  1. BENY NAHAR ROAD (IRE)
  2. AIMERIC
  3. WILLIAM YEATS

races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse For Outdoor Events Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The vote goes to LITTLETOWN LAD, who looks capable of confirming last month's C&D form with Character Testing, while handicap debutant Twilight Safari needs a close look with Brian Hughes taking over.

  1. LITTLETOWN LAD (IRE)
  2. CHARACTER TESTING
  3. TWILIGHT SAFARI

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap
races.verdict:
A golden opportunity for FEMME FATALE, who has upped her game since tackling 2m and got off the mark with a gutsy display at Lingfield just over 5 weeks ago. Virtue Diligence has race fitness on his side, so he's preferred to the returning Ramensky for the forecast spot.

  1. FEMME FATALE
  2. VIRTUE DILIGENCE
  3. RAMENSKY

races.name: Bet At racingtv.com Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
OCEAN FORCE wasn't seen to best effect having been very well backed on handicap debut at Lingfield last month and remaining lightly raced for his age, Gary & Josh Moore's 5-y-o is worth another chance to open his account with a first-time tongue tie applied. Lovely Jubly caused a 40/1 shock on return over C&D 10 weeks ago, so she rates as an obvious danger, with Lady Margret one to note for the places.

  1. OCEAN FORCE (IRE)
  2. LOVELY JUBLY
  3. LADY MARGRET (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for a few of these but the most persuasive is for BIRD OF WAR, who gave the impression he'd benefit from a return to this trip when third at Lingfield last month. Heading up the dangers is Decalogue, who is steadily improving in handicaps and first-time cheekpieces could be just what he requires. Unionville and Berkshire Boom can fight out third.

  1. BIRD OF WAR (IRE)
  2. DECALOGUE (USA)
  3. UNIONVILLE

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SOLAR SWING's debut at Newbury was full of promise and with plenty from his excellent stable improving markedly on second run, he is taken to do likewise. National Honour will stay further than this but he's a well-bred last-time-out winner with the scope to go on improving, so he's a threat, along with Farasan.

  1. SOLAR SWING (IRE)
  2. NATIONAL HONOUR (IRE)
  3. FARASAN

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GUADALEVIN was a shade disappointing at Carlisle 4 weeks ago but she sets a pretty solid standard on her best form and well drawn to attack back on the all-weather with a hood on, she's worth another chance. Grey Tamam is the obvious threat, though Bling and Pure Majesty are open to improvement.

  1. GUADALEVIN (IRE)
  2. GREY TAMAM (IRE)
  3. BLING (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ENCORE had no answers to a former Ed Walker stablemate at Windsor 3 weeks ago but expected to step forward from that run, she may account for the standard-setting filly Forbidden Colours representing that aforementioned trainer. Mystic Veil will surely know more this time and she can elevate her form.

  1. ENCORE (FR)
  2. FORBIDDEN COLOURS (IRE)
  3. MYSTIC VEIL

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
SAX AVOIDANCE was an impressive winner on handicap debut at Salisbury on Friday and can defy a penalty/3-day turnaround to follow up. Hot Silk and Three Socks On are next on the shortlist.

  1. SAX AVOIDANCE (IRE)
  2. HOT SILK
  3. THREE SOCKS ON

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
BEELZEBUB failed to fire last time but having struck up a good relationship with this apprentice, Tony Carroll's 6-y-o is afforded the vote returned to all-weather. Happier arrives in top form, so she rates as an obvious danger, with Angel Summer and stable-switcher Roy Lane taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. BEELZEBUB (IRE)
  2. HAPPIER (IRE)
  3. ANGEL SUMMER (IRE)

races.name: Constant Security Services Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SATYRESS is thriving and can defy a further rise to complete the 4-timer in another ordinary handicap. Dream of Ithaca was fortunate to win at Ffos Las last time but arrives in better form than most and rates the main danger, while Hickton can also be involved if continuing to settle.

  1. SATYRESS
  2. DREAM OF ITHACA
  3. HICKTON (IRE)

races.name: Patrick Hibbert-Foy Memorial Nursery
races.verdict:
BLADEY LADY and Claret Time dominated the finish of a similar event at Newcastle earlier this month and are taken to come to the fore again, with Tim Easterby’s charge fancied to confirm that form despite a 4 lb rise. Claret And Blues showed a bit more over C&D last time and can be involved if taking another step forward.

  1. BLADEY LADY (IRE)
  2. CLARET TIME
  3. CLARET AND BLUES

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DIAMONSFORYOU shaped well on debut and, with the step up to 7f likely to suit, is taken to improve enough to get off the mark at the second attempt. Majestic Jude impressed when scoring at Newmarket last time but may struggle to concede 11 lb to the selection, while the scopey Master Celeritas is also open to improvement.

  1. DIAMONDSFORYOU (IRE)
  2. MAJESTIC JUDE (IRE)
  3. MASTER CELERITAS

races.name: Sapphire Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
LAMLASH BAY remains lightly raced and will take plenty of beating in a very ordinary sprint handicap if bouncing back to the form he showed when winning at Ripon in July. Fan Mail took a step back in the right direction in a first-time visor at Carlisle 5 days ago and rates the main threat, while Record Day returns to the scene of his best effort in first-time blinkers and should strip fitter for his recent run.

  1. LAMLASH BAY
  2. RECORD DAY
  3. FAN MAIL

races.name: decronhorsecare.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
A strong pace could just tip this in favour of THORNABY ANNIE. Front-running Hatamoto likes it here and may well make another bold bid. Real Jack and Showtown complete the shortlist.

  1. THORNABY ANNIE (IRE)
  2. HATAMOTO
  3. REAL JACK

races.name: Join Racing TV Today Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
DONNA NOOK makes plenty of appeal on her best form and could be worth another chance in this grade. Headstrong Always Blue is capable of better in handicaps and needs considering, along with Ravishing Beauty, who is back on her latest winning mark.

  1. DONNA NOOK
  2. ALWAYS BLUE
  3. RAVISHING BEAUTY

races.name: Bowel Cancer Screening Programme Saves Lives Handicap
races.verdict:
RED HAT EAGLE was beaten only by an unexposed 3-y-o in this grade last time, and he's fancied to go one better here. Avatar Jet, Novak and The Childe of Hale all have solid claims at the weights in a competitive finale.

  1. RED HAT EAGLE
  2. AVATAR JET (IRE)
  3. NOVAK

races.name: Matchbook Signup - Get 20% Back On Losses Handicap
races.verdict:
A tricky handicap that may go the way of the unexposed KIANI KING in his attempt to follow up his Southwell success. Ribenska and Newfangled head the list of dangers in that order.

  1. KIANI KING (IRE)
  2. RIBENSKA (IRE)
  3. NEWFANGLED (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Several hold solid claims here but preference is for RED BLUE POINT, who arrives here after making the frame in a valuable Newmarket sales event. Urumita's debut effort can be marked up and the Richard Hannon-trained filly makes appeal, with similar consideration given to Instant Force, who now sports first-time cheekpieces.

  1. RED BLUE POINT (IRE)
  2. URUMITA (IRE)
  3. INSTANT FORCE (IRE)

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WOOTZ made such an impression on debut that he's expected to defy a penalty. Song of The Clouds is next best from interesting newcomer Journalism.

  1. WOOTZ (IRE)
  2. SONG OF THE CLOUDS (IRE)
  3. JOURNALISM

races.name: Kim Smith Memorial Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
QUEEN OF SCOTLAND is hard to oppose here on the back of her debut showing, with well-bred newcomer Crown of Crowns appealing most of the opposition.

  1. QUEEN OF SCOTLAND
  2. CROWN OF CROWNS
  3. SEACOLE (IRE)

races.name: Ivor Laws Memorial Race Handicap
races.verdict:
REBEL PATH benefited from a change of headgear when scoring in gutsy fashion here a week ago and, without a penalty for that success, he is taken to follow up. Kiss And Run also arrives on the back of a recent win and is feared most, ahead of the hat-trick seeking Cape Toronada.

  1. REBEL PATH (FR)
  2. KISS AND RUN
  3. CAPE TORONADA (FR)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BRIGID'S WELL had edged down the weights prior to making the frame at Goodwood 2 weeks ago and she gets the verdict with her mark unchanged. Aravalli continues to progress and is respected, with John T an interesting candidate on his belated seasonal return.

  1. BRIGID'S WELL (IRE)
  2. ARAVALLI (IRE)
  3. JOHN T

races.name: NSI Fire & Security Handicap
races.verdict:
CRAZY PLAN has made a solid start in handicaps and makes most appeal in a thin race. Offiah's Boy arrives in decent heart and can pose the biggest threat ahead of Electric Bass.

  1. CRAZY PLAN
  2. OFFIAH'S BOY
  3. ELECTRIC BASS

races.name: Neverland Drone Show At Windsor Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
DRAGON GOD has an eye-catching jockey booking on first start for this yard and can resume winning ways at the expense of Enter Sandman, who's dropped back down to a handy mark. Darkened Edge and Faustus are another pair to consider.

  1. DRAGON GOD
  2. ENTER SANDMAN (IRE)
  3. DARKENED EDGE
